name: Onesuku! ~Onee-san Scramble~
original_name: おねすく！～おねえさんすくらんぶる～
source:
After a long story, Masashi starts to live with his old friend, Sumika. Two women get together with them and one man and three women begin to live together. Masashi's life turns to a paradise but actually no woman sees him as a man. Can he be a real man and win their hearts?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
经历一番波折后，正志开始与旧友澄香同住。随后又有两名女性加入，1男3女就此开始共同生活。正志的人生仿佛化作天堂，可实际上，没有一名女性把他当成男人看待。他能否成为真正的男子汉，赢得她们的芳心？

[摘自ErogeShop]
